modelOverview: The Datejust 36 is the direct descendant of the original 1945 Oyster Perpetual Datejust, the first self-winding waterproof chronometer wristwatch to display the date in a window on the dial. The 36mm case remains the classic Datejust proportion, worn equally by men and women, and the current generation introduced in 2019 runs the automatic Calibre 3235 with a roughly 70-hour power reserve. It is offered in Oystersteel, Rolesor and solid gold, with smooth, fluted or gem-set bezels, Oyster or Jubilee bracelets and one of the broadest dial ranges in the Rolex catalogue.

126234.description: The White Rolesor Datejust 36 pairs an Oystersteel case and bracelet with a fluted 18ct white gold bezel, giving the archetypal Datejust silhouette while reading as predominantly steel. Introduced in 2019 with the Calibre 3235, it is offered on either the five-link Jubilee or three-link Oyster bracelet across a wide choice of dials. Every example we offer is individually sourced and fully authenticated.
